tasks.title: Investigate current reverse-scoring documentation and identify all gaps
tasks.description: Read GC-SDOH.md and docs/ADAPTIVE-ASSESSMENT-PATTERN.md to catalog every location that references reverse scoring, normalization, or risk thresholds. Identify the exact lines where the normalization formula is promised but missing, and confirm which questions are reverse-scored versus which should be.
acceptanceCriteria: File `GC-SDOH.md` line 22 contains 'scoring normalization handles this automatically' — confirms the gap exists
File `GC-SDOH.md` line 237 contains 'Scoring algorithms handle reverse-scored questions automatically' — confirms no formula is provided

tasks.title: Add explicit reverse-scoring normalization formula to Scoring System section
tasks.description: Replace the vague 'Scoring algorithms handle reverse-scored questions automatically' statement in GC-SDOH.md (lines 236-237) with an explicit normalization formula: normalized_score = (scale_max + scale_min) - raw_score, i.e., for 1-5 scale: normalized = 6 - raw. This makes the scoring unambiguous for implementers.
acceptanceCriteria: File `GC-SDOH.md` no longer contains the string 'Scoring algorithms handle reverse-scored questions automatically'
File `GC-SDOH.md` contains an explicit formula or equation for reverse-score normalization in the Scoring & Interpretation section

acceptanceCriteria: File `GC-SDOH.md` line 22 area no longer contains 'scoring normalization handles this automatically'
File `GC-SDOH.md` line 22 area contains a reference to the Scoring & Interpretation section or to the reverse-scoring formula
